title: 第一卷 第23章 长生观祖师第一卷 第24章 浪费那钱干啥师叔会做
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了
content_zh:
;;
李寒舟原身的记忆里也没有太多的资料，显然这货以前不光不修炼，就连长生观的事情都不管。
仗着是观主的师弟，所以就在这里当个蛀虫了。
“师叔，你在这里做什么？”这个时候，柳东岳刚刚修炼回来，看到李寒舟站在大殿的面前，不禁上来好奇的问。
“大殿怎么锁了。”李寒舟回头说道。
“师叔，自从师父失踪之后，我们长生观弟子走的走，散的散，更是已经很久都没有香客来上香了，我们之前也没有钱买香火供奉祖师了，所以就给锁上了，师叔怎么突然想起来来大殿看看了。”柳东岳有些好奇，这师叔最近真的是转性子了，以前八百年都不会来大殿。
今天这是怎么了？
“想看看。”李寒舟点点头：“钥匙在谁那里？”
“在大师兄手里吧？”柳东岳不确定的说。
“话说你们大师兄还没回来？他是去除妖去了，还是被妖怪给吃了？”李寒舟无语的说。
柳东岳表示也不知道。
既然钥匙不在，李寒舟直接走上前去，手中光芒一闪，秋葬就出现在手里，一刀下去，那锁头就直接烂掉了。
“好刀！”
看到这刀如此锋利，柳东岳眼睛亮了。
“不过这刀看着怎么那么眼熟呢？”柳东岳挠挠头，那把刀的造型自己好像在哪里看过，但是一时间却也是想不起来了。
“不过师叔又有储物袋了？”柳东岳看的眼馋，他也很想要一个。
李寒舟此时已经推开门走进去了。
嘎吱。
门板发出了摩擦的声音，紧接着铺面而来的就是一股发霉的味道，到处都是烟尘，李寒舟用手扇了扇，大殿很大，但是灰尘遍地，甚至还有不少的蜘蛛网。
看得出来是很久都没有人进来了。

中间有一个巨大的香炉，里面仅仅是残存的香灰。
而当李寒舟抬起头看前面那巨大的祖师雕像的时候，李寒舟竟然愣在当场。
那长生观的祖师，模样竟然是那般的熟悉！
那张脸，自己怎么可能忘记？
那是老道士的模样啊！
“老道士？”李寒舟揉了揉自己的眼睛，怀疑自己是不是思念过度，所以才看错了，可是不管怎么看，那都是老道士那张脸。
尤其是那个大酒糟鼻，完全是一模一样的啊。
这是怎么回事？
为什么长生观的祖师和老道士长得一模一样？
是巧合吗？
“师叔，你怎么了？”柳东岳走进来，看到李寒舟正对着祖师像发呆，于是有些好奇的上来询问。
“这位就是我们长生观的祖师？”李寒舟平静了一下自己的呼吸，然后问。
“对啊，此人就是我们长生观的开山鼻祖。”柳东岳点点头。
这种事来长生观之后自然会知晓。
“他叫什么名字？”李寒舟又问。
柳东岳还以为李寒舟在考自己，于是也认真的说道：“师叔，这样的问题我作为长生观的弟子自然是记得的，师祖他老人家的名讳叫做李清风，曾经江湖上人称清风道祖，想当年我们长生观有清风道祖在，那可是威风凛凛，清风道祖是真正的天下第一！”

There is not much information in Li Hanzhou's original memory. It is obvious that not only did this guy not practice before, he didn't even care about the concept of immortality.
Since he is the disciple of the temple master, he is just a moron here.
"Uncle Master, what are you doing here?" At this time, Liu Dongyue had just returned from practicing. When he saw Li Hanzhou standing in front of the main hall, he couldn't help but come up and ask curiously.
"Why is the hall locked?" Li Hanzhou turned around and said.
"Uncle Master, since Master disappeared, we disciples of Changsheng Temple have been wandering around and dispersed. It has been a long time since pilgrims came to offer incense. We did not have money to buy incense to worship the ancestor, so we locked it up. Why did Uncle Master suddenly want to come to the hall to take a look." Liu Dongyue was a little curious. This uncle has really changed his temper recently. He would not come to the hall in the past 800 years.
What happened today?
"I want to take a look." Li Hanzhou nodded: "Who has the key?"
"In the hands of senior brother, right?" Liu Dongyue said uncertainly.
"By the way, your senior brother hasn't come back yet? Did he get rid of the monster, or was he eaten by the monster?" Li Hanzhou said speechlessly.
Liu Dongyue said he didn’t know either.
Since the key was not there, Li Hanzhou stepped forward directly. With a flash of light in his hand, Qiubian appeared in his hand. With one stab, the lock rotted away.
"Good knife!"
Liu Dongyue's eyes lit up when he saw how sharp the knife was.
"But why does this knife look so familiar?" Liu Dongyue scratched his head. He seemed to have seen the shape of the knife somewhere, but he couldn't remember it for a while.
"But uncle, does he have a storage bag again?" Liu Dongyue looked at it with envy, he also wanted one very much.
Li Hanzhou had already opened the door and walked in.
Crunch.
The door panel made a friction sound, followed by a musty smell from the pavement, and smoke and dust everywhere. Li Hanzhou fanned it with his hand. The hall was large, but dust was everywhere, and there were even a lot of spider webs.
It could be seen that no one had come in for a long time.
There is a huge incense burner in the middle, which contains only the remaining incense ashes.
And when Li Hanzhou raised his head and looked at the huge statue of the ancestor in front of him, Li Hanzhou was stunned on the spot.
The founder of the Immortality Concept looks so familiar!
How could I forget that face?
That’s what an old Taoist priest looks like!
"Old Taoist priest?" Li Hanzhou rubbed his eyes, wondering if he missed it too much, so he saw it wrong, but no matter how he looked at it, it was the face of the old Taoist priest.
Especially the big rosacea, it's exactly the same.
What's going on?
Why do the founder of Changshengguan and the old Taoist priest look exactly the same?
Is it a coincidence?
"Uncle Master, what's wrong with you?" Liu Dongyue walked in and saw Li Hanzhou staring at the statue of the Patriarch, so he came up to ask curiously.
"Is this the founder of our Immortality Concept?" Li Hanzhou calmed his breathing and then asked.
"Yes, this person is the originator of our view of longevity." Liu Dongyue nodded.
You will naturally know this kind of thing after you come to the Immortality View.
"What's his name?" Li Hanzhou asked again.
Liu Dongyue thought that Li Hanzhou was testing himself, so he said seriously: "Uncle Master, as a disciple of the Immortality Temple, I naturally remember such questions. The master's nickname is Li Qingfeng. People in the world used to call him Qingfeng Taozu. I think back then, we had Qingfeng Taoist in the longevity temple. He was so majestic. Qingfeng Taozu was truly the best in the world!"
